        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="22" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">承诺书</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">本人声明所呈交的博士学位论文是本人在导师指导下进行的研究工作及取得的研究成果。除了文中特别加以标注和致谢的地方外，论文中不包含其他人已经发表或撰写过的研究成果，也不包含为获得南京航空航天大学或其他教育机构的学位或证书而使用过的材料。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">本人授权南京航空航天大学可以将学位论文的全部或部分内容编入有关数据库进行检索，可以采用影印、缩印或扫描等复制手段保存、汇编学位论文。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">（保密的学位论文在解密后适用本承诺书）</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="single">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="single">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="single">日期：</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="15" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="1" styleName="heading 1">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="15" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="15" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">摘要</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云计算</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">通过将云计算和移动互联网</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">技术相</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">结合，实现优势互补，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">给移动用户带来</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">更加便捷的云服务。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">然而随着移动云计算的普及，移动云计算的资源管理也遇到了新的问题。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动互联网在带来便捷性的同时，也给移动云计算带来更多的随机性，因此也给移动云计算的资源管理带来了新的挑战。如何对移动云计算数据中心的资源进行动态合理地管理以最大化数据中心的效用已成为目前移动云计算领域的研究热点之一。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">针对上述问题，本文在分析了移动云计算数据中心资源分配特点的基础上，分别对移动云计算的资源调度、负载预测以及移动云的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">故障</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">机制等方面展开了系统而深入的研究。本文的主要创新工作概括如下：</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）针对移动云数据中心的高能耗问题，建立了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">数据中心的资源模型和动态能耗模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">；基于该模型，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">提出了一种面向移动云计算的四维度虚拟资源调度算法（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">FVRSA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">），将资源分配过程划分为三个阶段</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">：资源</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">初始</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">分配、资源</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">动态调度</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">和资源</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">全局</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">优化</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">；</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">并以能耗最低为优化目标</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">针对上述三个阶段</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">分别设计了三种优化算法进行求解，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">通过仿真实验</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">对</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">所提出的模型与算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">进行了验证</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在降低</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云，资源管理，资源调度，负载预测，故障检测</plain_text>
      </text_run>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">ABSTRACT</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Cloud computing and mobile internet technologies to integrate more and better cloud technologies and mobile internet technologies to achieve easier and brings more convenient cloud services to mobile users. However, with the popularization of mobile cloud computing, resource management for mobile cloud computing also encounters new problems. While bringing convenience, mobile Internet also brings more uncertainties to mobile cloud computing, which also brings new challenges to the resource management of mobile cloud computing. How to dynamically and reasonably manage the resources of the mobile cloud computing data centers to maximize the effectiveness of data centers data has become one of The research hotspots in the field of mobile cloud computing.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The major innovations in this analysis are the features of mobile cloud computing data centers resource allocation, and systematically and closely studies the resource scheduling, load forecasting and fault tolerance mechanisms of mobile cloud computing. :</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(1) To solve the high energy consumption problem of mobile cloud data centers, a resource model and a dynamic energy consumption model of mobile cloud data centers are established. Based on this model, a four-dimensional virtual resource scheduling algorithm (FVRSA) for Mobile cloud computing is proposed. The resource allocation process is divided into three phases: initial resource allocation, dynamic resource scheduling, and global resource optimization. We also design three optimization algorithms aiming to minimize the energy consumption in the three phases. Model and algorithms by conducting simulation experiments.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(2) To reduce the energy consumption of mobile cloud data centers while improving the effectiveness of data centers, a virtual machine scheduling model VMSA-EU was established based on multi-objective optimization technology. Aiming to minimize the energy consumption and maximize utility of data The experimental results show that the proposed algorithms have better performances in both scheduling time and the NSGAII-based virtual machine scheduling algorithm was proposed to solve the model. The effectiveness of the model and algorithms are verified by simulation experiments comparing with similar algorithms. Scheduling results.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(3) To solve the host load forecasting problem in mobile cloud computing, the wavelet support vector regression model is introduced to establish a hybrid wavelet support vector regression host load forecasting algorithm. By studying the load data of the mobile cloud computing data center hosts, The simulation of the prediction of load data based on the wavelet support vector regression model. By </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">solving the model parameters using the firefly swarm optimization algorithm, the prediction accuracy of the model is increased. In the simulation experiments, the proposed algorithm is compared with similar prediction algorithms. The Experimental results show that the proposed prediction algorithm is better than the similar prediction algorithms in prediction accuracy.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(4) To improve the usability of mobile cloud data centers, we improved the ARMA model. A double-layer heartbeat detection model and double-layer heartbeat detection algorithm (DLHB) for mobile cloud computing are proposed. The algorithm is composed of ARIMA- Based on inter-domain heartbeat prediction algorithm and the intra-domain heartbeat detection algorithm. Experimental results show that the proposed DLHB algorithm can detect multiple node failures at the same time within a shorter detection time.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(5) To fulfill the requirements of industry applications, the overall architecture of the mobile private cloud resource management platform for ship formation is designed using related theories. The proposed model and algorithms are implemented and tested. The functions and performance of the platform are also Tested and analyzed.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

      <table_row tag="table_row" index="16">
        <table_cell tag="table_cell" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" column="0">
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MOP</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
        </table_cell>
        <table_cell tag="table_cell" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" column="1">
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Multi-objective Optimization Problem</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
        </table_cell>
        <table_cell tag="table_cell" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" column="2">
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">多目标优化问题</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
        </table_cell>
      </table_row>
    </table>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="15" fontColor="#000000" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="1" styleName="heading 1">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="15" fontColor="#000000" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="15" fontColor="#000000" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">绪论</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云计算是</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云计算</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">技术</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">与移动网络技术的结合体，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">是云计算技术在移动网络的延伸</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。由于移动终端具有</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动性和便捷性，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">因此</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">用户能够</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">随时随地</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">方便地使用云服务。然而，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">用户</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">具有分布性、</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">流动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">性等特点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，服务</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">申请</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">往往具有</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">不确定性</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">且</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">用户</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">对服务</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">质量</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">要求较高</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">给</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云数据中心的资源管理带来了挑战。移动云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">数据中心</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">资源管理技术是移动云计算领域的研究热点之一。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="黑体" fontSize="14" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="21" styleName="heading 2">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="黑体" fontSize="14" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="黑体" fontSize="14" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">研究背景</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">随着云计算技术的发展和普及</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云计算对商业的支持越来越丰富，且使用云计算的成本也越来越低。近</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">年来，国内外的传统信息产业纷纷转型并使用云计算技术，云计算的规模越来越大。为了满足越来越多的中小型企业的云服务需求，云计算服务提供商需要不断扩大云数据中心的规模，而每个数据中心都有巨大的能耗，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">因此</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">整个云数据中心的能耗变得越来越大。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">根据世界知名市场咨询、顾问和活动服务专业提供商</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ICTresearch</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">资源公司的调查研究显报告示得知，截至</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2016</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">年底，中国的云数据中心数量保守估计有</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">5.6</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">万个</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，总面积约为</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1650</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">万平方米</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中国云计算数据中心节能现状深度分析</plain_text>

      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">应用</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">应用</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。为了最大化云服务提供商的利益，需要对数据中心的资源进行管理，一方面为了降低数据中心的能耗，另一方面是为了提升云计算系统的效率，从而提升接入云计算的企业</plain_text>

      </text_run>

      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">随着近年来移动互联网的发展，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">4G</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">/5G</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">技术瓶颈的不断突破，以及各种智能移动终端</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">和相关服务</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">APP</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">普及，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动互联网已经</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">渗透到人们生活</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">、</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">工作的方方面面</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。移动互联网因其接入终端的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">资源有限</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">特点限制了人们的使用，而移动云计算的出现</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">很好地解决了这个问题</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。移动云计算利用近乎无限的资源填补了移动互联网</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">终端资源</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">不足</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，使得移动终端可以通过</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">网络获取云端服务，近年来受到国内外学者的关注。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云计算数据中心资源管理仍然是</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云领域的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">研究热点。相比于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">传统</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云，移动云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">特别是移动私有云资源具有多样、有限、分布、异构、动态等特点，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">而</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">用户</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">申请服务具有随机性，且对</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">服务质量</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">要求更高</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">；</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">另外，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">受移动终端性能和网络带宽等物理条件</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">约束，移动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">私有</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云计算中的资源管理问题变得更加复杂。因此，如何对移动云计算中的资源</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">进行有效</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">管理从而</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在提高</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">数据中心资源利用率</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的同时又降低</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">能耗</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">、确保资源高可用</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">是目前移动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">私有</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的热点问题，也是本文的研究重点所在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="黑体" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="31" styleName="heading 3">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="黑体" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="黑体" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云计算</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="黑体" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="黑体" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">概述</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">随着移动设备的更迭加速和无线网络的蓬勃</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">发展，移动互联网得以飞速发展。移动设备的性能不断增强，其功能也</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">日益丰富。根据艾瑞数据的统计，我国拥有世界上最大的网民数量，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2017</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">年我国的网民总数达到</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">7.5</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">亿人，其中移动网民</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">就有</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">7.3</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">亿人，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">近年来</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动网民</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">一直保持着</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">5.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">3%</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的增速</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。随着无线网络技术的发展，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">3G</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">/4G</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">以及</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">5G</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">技术的出现，人们对移动设备</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">需求不断增强</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。从现在的即时</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Satyanarayanan&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;1993&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;79&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[3]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;79&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="ve25zvdskavf9nesxvkv9a07fdftwwt0w0v9"&gt;79&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Satyanarayanan, M.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Mobile computing&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Computer&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Computer&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;81-82&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;26&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;9&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;1993&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的这些固有</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动设备</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">功能和性能</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">需求的上升</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">需要不断突破</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">本身的资源</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">瓶颈，才能满足人们的需求。然而，硬件的提升需要新材料新技术的突破。目前移动设备存在的难以解决的问题，包括移动设备的存储有限，电池续航能力有限，设备的处理能力有限等等，都需要新材料技术的突破，才能够使移动设备的性能达到质的飞跃，而这些突破无法在短期实现。而云计算技术的出现，使得移动设备固有的缺点得以弥补。云平台上有近乎无限的计算资源和存储资源，能够满足移动终端的各种高性能计算，并提供给移动终端最优的云服务。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="-h" styleName="正文-h">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云计算技术是</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">IT</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">行业中的一个热点技术，在过去的十几年里，其概念和理论在不断发展，由并行计算、分布式计算、网格计算、效用计算等多种传统技术发展融合而来</plain_text>
      </text_run>

      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Mobile</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> Cloud computing</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MCC</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）将移动互联网技术与云计算技术相结合</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Dinh&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2013&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;83&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[7]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;83&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="ve25zvdskavf9nesxvkv9a07fdftwwt0w0v9"&gt;83&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Dinh, Hoang T.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Lee, Chonho&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Niyato, Dusit&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wang, Ping&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;A survey of mobile cloud computing: architecture, applications, and approaches&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Wireless Communications &amp;amp; Mobile Computing&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Wireless Communications &amp;amp; Mobile Computing&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;1587–1611&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;13&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;18&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2013&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>

      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，利用云计算具备的海量存储能力和高速计算能力，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">弥补移动设备运算性能、续航能力和存储空间不足的缺点，从而为移动用户提供高效实时的服务。移动云计算的最终目标是能够支持多种移动设备上执行丰富的移动应用，从而为用户带来丰富的用户体验</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Abolfazli&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2014&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;84&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[8]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;84&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="ve25zvdskavf9nesxvkv9a07fdftwwt0w0v9"&gt;84&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Abolfazli, Saeid&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Sanaei, Zohreh&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Gani, Abdullah&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Xia, Feng&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yang, Laurence T&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Rich Mobile Applications: Genesis, taxonomy, and open issues&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Journal of Network &amp;amp; Computer Applications&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Journal of Network &amp;amp; Computer Applications&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;345-362&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;40&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;7&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2014&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
