        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，该方法通过设计未知输入的观测器得到系统输出值</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Juričić</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为了解决在建模错误时检测传感器故障问题，提出了一种统计检验</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Juričić&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2002&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;23&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[47]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;23&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;23&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Đani Juričić&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Žele, Mina&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Robust detection of sensor faults by means of a statistical</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> test </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">☆</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Automatica&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Automatica&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;737-742&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;38&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;4&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2002&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndN</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_47">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">47</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，使用随机嵌入技术适当考虑欠模型的影响。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">基于状态估计和基于参数估计的检测方法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">这</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">两种方法各有优劣，基于状态估计的检测方法实时性较好但收敛性较差；基于参数估计的方法要求存在激烈信号，而基于状态估计的检测方法没有严格要求。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">随着技术的发展，分布式系统逐渐被云计算系统代替，系统复杂度不断提升</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，基于模型的检测方法在建模时越来越困难</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">因此产生了不依赖模型的检测方法，其主要分为基于信号的方法和基于知识的方法。基于信号的方法通过对输出信号的参数进行分析来获得故障信息。基于知识的方法包括利用模糊逻辑的方法、</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Petri</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">网的方法等智能方法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Akhmetov&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2001&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;156&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[48]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;156&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="ve25zvdskavf9nesxvkv9a07fdftwwt0w0v9"&gt;156&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Akhmetov, D. F.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Dote, Y&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Ovaska, S. J.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Fuzzy neural network with general parameter adaptation for modeling of nonlinear time-series&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;148-52&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;12&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;1&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2001&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_48">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">48</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">包括遗传算法以及神经网络等优化算法已被运用到模型参数的优化中</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Li&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2000&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;15&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[49]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;15&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;15&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Li, Xiaoou&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yu, Wen&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Lara-Rosano, F.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Dynamic knowledge inference and learning under adaptive fuzzy Petri net framework&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;IEEE Transactions on Systems Man &amp;amp; Cybernetics Part C&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;IEEE Transactions on Systems Man &amp;amp; Cybernetics Part C&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;442-450&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;30&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;4&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2000&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_49">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">49</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，但存在收敛速度慢、拟合精度较低等问题。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">针对移动云计算系统的容错问题，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">目前</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">国内外学者</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">已经提出了大量故障检测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">较早提出的算法为</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">t-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">故障一步检测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Aguilera&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;1997&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;6&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[50]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;6&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;6&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Aguilera, Marcos Kawazoe&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Chen, Wei&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Toueg, Sam&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Heartbeat: A timeout-free failure detector for quiescent reliable communication&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;International Workshop on Distributed Algorithms&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;126-140&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;1997&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_50">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">50</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，该算法中每个节点可被至少其余</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">t</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">各节点检测且任意两节点之间不可检测</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于其条件要求严格，在实际应用中很难得到满足，故研究人员又提出了心跳检测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">该算法通过节点向其他节点发送心跳包来判断节点是否出现故障</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">但随着系统规模增大，通信量成非线性增长趋势，后续研究者们又提出了很多动态心跳检测算法，将系统当前的网络状况等因素考虑到算法中，有效地减少了心跳检测的通信量。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在故障检测算法中</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，心跳检测方法为最普遍且容易实现的方法。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">最常用的心跳</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">有“主</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">动模型”和“被动模型”。顾名思义，“主动模型”指的是被监视者主动向监视者定期发送心跳报文，告知自身正常；相反，“被动模型”中，被监视者自身不主动发送心跳报文，通过监视者主动周期向被监视者发送询问报文，被监视者收到询问报文后回复自己的状态信息。然而主被动模型分别具有均有不尽人意之处。当网络负载过重时，主动模型中可能存在着监控者无法按时收到被监控者心跳报文的情况，从而导致对被监控者状态的错误判断；对于被动模型，一次状态监测过程需要“询问”、“回复”两次网络通信，效率较主动模型低；近年来，学者们基于主被动模型开展了广泛的研究，取得了一系列研究成果。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">“双模型”</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Ginoux&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2014&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;160&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[51]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;160&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="ve25zvdskavf9nesxvkv9a07fdftwwt0w0v9"&gt;160&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Ginoux, Jean-Marc&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Rossetto, Bruno&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Slow invariant manifold of heartbeat model&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;arXiv preprint arXiv:1408.4988&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;arXiv preprint arXiv:1408.4988&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2014&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_51">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">51</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">是一种针对“</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">主动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型”误判率高和“</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">被动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型”通信开销大的缺点而设计的心跳检测模型。它结合了“</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">主动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型”和“</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">被动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型”的优点，其工作过程可以分为两个阶段：在阶段一，所有被监控节点周期性地</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">主动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">发送心跳</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">报文</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。若监控节点在某</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">段时间内（若干个心跳周期）</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">没有收到被监控节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">发送</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的心跳</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">报文</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，则进入第二个阶段，向被监控节点询问其状态信息；若被监控节点未发生故障，则在收到询问信息后向</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">询问节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">回复自己的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">工作状态</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。“双模型”简单地将“</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">主动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型”与“</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">被动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型”相结合，其实现简单，但对于规模较大的集群系统，大量的心跳包会影响网络性能。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">国内西安交通大学的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Z. Hou</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人提出了一种分布式心跳机制（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Distributed Heartbeat Mechanism</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DHM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Hou&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2003&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;12&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[52]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;12&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;12&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Hou, Zonghao&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Huang, Yongxiang&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zheng, Shouqi&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Dong, Xiaoshe&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wang, Bingkang&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Design and implementation of heartbeat in multi-machine environment&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;International Conference on Advanced Information NETWORKING and Applications&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;583-586&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2003&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_52">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">52</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">该机制首先各个节点选举产生</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">一个主节点，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">主节点周期采用“拉模型”</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">检测</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">其余各个</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">节点的状态信息。而主节点的状态则由各从节点协同判断，从节点首先向主节点“拉”回其状态信息，若在一个预期时间内未收到回复，则从节点会选举判断主节点的状态信息。若主节点失效，则新主节点的选举会在所有从节点中进行，这样对于较大规模的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云计算系统</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，网络开销也是相当大的。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">哈尔滨工业大学的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Feifei</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人提出了一种多级心跳协议（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Multi-Level Heartbeat Protocol</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MLHP</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Li&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2009&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;13&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[53]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;13&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;13&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Book"&gt;6&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Li, Fei Fei&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yu, Xiang Zhan&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wu, Gang&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Design and Implementation of High Availability Distributed System Based on Multi-level Heartbeat Protocol&lt;/title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;83-87&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2009&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;publisher&gt;IEEE Computer Society&lt;/publisher&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_53">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">53</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">该协议是由两种心跳协议组成：多点心跳协议和双向心跳协议。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">多级心跳协议非常方便节点加入和离开心跳协议，也可以避免单点故障导致系统发生致命故障。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">最后</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">实现一个基于多级心跳协议的高可用性分布式系统，同时采用鱼效应和任务重分配机制来避免单点故障。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，该算法可以适应不同作业大小的情况，当节点作业相对较小时，为了避免频繁的心跳检测而增加网络负载会降低心跳频率，而作业相对较大时，为了能够及时发现节点故障会尽量增加心跳频率。但该算法忽略了网络环境的影响，因此不能很好地适用于网络环境多变的环境中。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">以上算法均</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">忽略了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云数据中心中网络的延时问题。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">特别是</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动私有云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">设备和网络</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的异构性</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">和多样性</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，各</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">主机</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">间的通信</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">时间存在较大差异</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">心跳报文的到达时间无法精确预测，误判的可能性就存在较大可能。例如由于网络堵塞，被监控主机心跳报文发送出去后未能按时到达监控主机，监控主机状态询问报文也无法及时得到回应，就会误判该监控节点故障。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为了解决这一问题，东北大学的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">易俗</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人提出了一种多因素心跳检测算法（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Multi Factor Adaptive Heartbeat Detection Algorithm</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MFAHDA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Su&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2017&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;22&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[55]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;22&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;22&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Su, Y. I.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yin, Huiwen&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wang, Chuang&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zhang, Yichuan&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Research on multi factor adaptive heartbeat detection algorithm&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Computer Engineering &amp;amp; Applications&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Computer Engineering &amp;amp; Applications&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2017&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_55">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">55</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">它采用“拉模型”的心跳机制，即让</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">监控节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">周期性地向</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">被监控</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">节点发送</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">工作状态查询报文</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">被监控</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">收到后</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">向</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">监控</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">回复</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">状态包</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。“拉模型”的网络开销要比推模型大得多，为了解决这个问题</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，易俗等人又设计了一个多因素心跳检测评价算法，该算法可以根据</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">CPU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">占用率，网络负载情况，作业大小三个因素自适应地调整主节点心跳询问信息的发送频率，综合各因素计算出适合当前系统的最优心跳频率，但其不足之处在于对较大型的服务器集群系统来说，采用主从式架构收集各节点的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">CPU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">占用率，网络负载情况，作业大小将会有较大的通信开销，且降低心跳频率并不能保证节点故障检测的准确率</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。因此，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在移动云计算大规模的数据中心上，依然会有效率较低的问题，因此该算法不能很好的适用于异构的移动云环境中。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">解放军装备学院的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">王浩铭等人提出了一种面向容灾自适应的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">PULL&amp;PUSH</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">心跳检测机制</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">一种面向容灾自适应的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">PULL&amp;amp;PUSH</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">心跳检测机制</plain_text>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;212-214&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;41&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;b11&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2014&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_56">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">56</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，将“拉模式”与“推模式”进行优势互补，并将网络环境考虑在内。该机制</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">利用了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">PUSH</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法的简单高效、节省开销的优点，同时进一步提高了检测机制的可靠性，虽然该心跳检测机制简化全盘使用“拉模式”的系统开销，但在复杂网络环境下其通讯开销以及检测准确率还需进一步提高，不能很好地适用于具有网络环境多样性特点的异构云环境中。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ZHANG</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人提出了基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MapReduce</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的多组容错机制</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

I.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Analysis and Study on under Cloud Computing Multiple Sets of Fault Tolerance Strategy Architecture of MapReduce&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Microelectronics &amp;amp; Computer&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Microelectronics &amp;amp; Computer&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2014&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>

      </text_run>
