    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="15" fontColor="#000000" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="1" styleName="heading 1">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="15" fontColor="#000000" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="15" fontColor="#000000" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">基于效用和能耗的移动云计算虚拟机调度算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">如何在降低数据中心能耗的同时又提高数据中心效用是目前移动云计算数据中心亟待解决的问题之一。本文基于多目标优化算法建立了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VMSA-EU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，将最小化数据中心能耗和最大化数据中心效用作为目标，并设计了基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">NSGAII</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度算法来求解该模型，最后通过仿真实验验证并将本文设计的算法和现有的同类算法进行对比实验。仿真结果表明，本文设计的基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">NSGAII</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度算法在进行</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度时，能在降低能耗的同时提高数据中心效用，并且在在执行时间和调度结果两方面都有所提高</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="21" styleName="heading 2">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">引言</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">近几年，计算和通信技术的进步增加了移动设备的使用，这导致了大量能量的消耗，给移动云计算中网络和云资源的管理带来了一些挑战，为了应对这些挑战，有必要开发一种虚拟机（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Virtual Machine</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）调度方法来对移动云数据中心的资源进行管理，以确保云计算的可伸缩性，可管理性，适应性，效率和可靠性。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="21" styleName="heading 2">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">相关研究</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云计算已经成为计算和资源存储的新商业模式，这种模式是基于对潜在大量远程数据中心功能的按需访问</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Lee&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2013&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;6&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[84]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;6&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="s2vrfef03etdpre50fbvxafjssw0r5ewr2tp" timestamp="1523587611"&gt;6&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Lee, Juhnyoung&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;A View Of Cloud Computing&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Communications of the Acm&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Communications of the Acm&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;50-58&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;53&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;4&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2013&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_84">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">84</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。随着云计算的快速发展，越来越多的数据中心已经建立。这些数据中心正在运行大量的应用程序，这些应用程序不仅消耗大量的计算和占用存储容量，而且还消耗大量的能源。据报道，美国的数据中心在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2011</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">年约占总电力消耗的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">3</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">％</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;STAR&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2016&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;18&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[85]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;18&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="s2vrfef03etdpre50fbvxafjssw0r5ewr2tp" timestamp="1523588885"&gt;18&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Web Page"&gt;12&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;ENERGY STAR&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Epa datacenter report congress&lt;/title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2016&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;related-urls&gt;&lt;url&gt;&lt;style face="underline" font="default" size="100%"&gt;http://www.energystar.gov/ia/partners/prod_development/downloads/EPA_Datacenter_Report_Congress_Final.pdf&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/url&gt;&lt;/related-urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_85">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">85</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，运营开支将超过到</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2015</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">年购买硬件的成本</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Microsoft&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2016&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;19&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[86]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;19&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="s2vrfef03etdpre50fbvxafjssw0r5ewr2tp" timestamp="1523589273"&gt;19&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Web Page"&gt;12&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Microsoft&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Microsoft environment-the green grid consortium&lt;/title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2016&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;related-urls&gt;&lt;url&gt;&lt;style face="underline" font="default" size="100%"&gt;http://www.microsoft.com/environment/our_commitment/articles/green_grid.aspx&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/url&gt;&lt;/related-urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_86">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">86</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。受这些事实的驱动，降低功耗和降低能源成本已成为当今数据中心运营商首要关注的问题。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在降低能耗的众多研究中，通过对虚拟资源的合理调度来降低数据中心的能耗一直是一个研究热点。为了提高数据中心的能源效率，许多研究者针对不同方面提出了一系列技术方法，包括更好的散热技术，温度控制，动态电压和频率调节，软件组件，资源虚拟化和负载均衡算法。数据中心节能的一种有效方法是动态调整数据中心容量，并通过调度算法为应用系统提供资源。然而，云计算领域的调度算法被认为是一个挑战，因为它需要对资源需求特征的仔细理解，以及考虑各种能源成本因素。传统调度算法更注重公平分配资源，但在大多数现实场景中，运行在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">上的不同的资源密集型应用程序也会对系统性能和能耗产生重要影响。因此，这些方面应该被认真考虑。云计算应用程序总是使用多种类型的资源，例如</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">CPU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，内存，网络带宽等等。从这个角度来看，调度各种资源的能力变得不可或缺。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为了解决</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度问题，许多专家学者根据自己的研究背景采用了不同的方法来解决。如</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Hancong Duan</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人为了避免瞬时高峰负载所引发的性能和能量损失，提出了基于分形数学的高效的预测模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Duan&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2016&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;7&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[37]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;7&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="s2vrfef03etdpre50fbvxafjssw0r5ewr2tp" timestamp="1523587622"&gt;7&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Duan, Hancong&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Chen, Chao&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Min, Geyong&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wu, Yu&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Energy-aware scheduling of virtual machines in heterogeneous cloud computing systems&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Future Generation Computer Systems&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Future Generation Computer Systems&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2016&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_37">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">37</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，该模型可以帮助算法决定打开或关闭主机。他们还提出了一种改进的蚁群算法，用于优化能耗，满足异构云计算环境下资源密集型应用需求。但是该方法只考虑的了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">CPU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">和磁盘的负载，忽略了网络带宽和内存的负载；上海计算机科学与软件工程学院可信计算重点实验室</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Kepi Zhang</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人重点关注在云计算环境中的超负载主机上选择</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的节能问题。分析</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">迁移过程中的能源影响因素，然后设计基于贪心算法和动态规划方法的节能</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">选择算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Zhang&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2017&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;8&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[87]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;8&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="s2vrfef03etdpre50fbvxafjssw0r5ewr2tp" timestamp="1523587651"&gt;8&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zhang, Kepi&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wu, Tong&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Chen, Siyuan&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Cai, Linsen&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Peng, Chao&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;A New Energy Efficient VM Scheduling Algorithm for Cloud Computing Based on Dynamic Programming&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Cloud Computing&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;249-254&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2017&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_87">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">87</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。该</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度算法很好的解决了能耗问题，但是没有考虑到用户的服务质量问题。文献</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> [</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">52</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的工作主要集中在利用模糊遗传</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DNA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">技术调度策略来降低云数据中心的能耗比，并有效地提高了云计算环境的资源利用率，但是也忽略了云用户的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">QoS</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">需求</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">A. Sathya Sofia</plain_text>

      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">P. Ganeshkumar</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">两人提出了一种通过动态调节电压和</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">频率来进行资源管理与能源控制的方法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Sofia&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2017&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;10&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[89]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;10&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="s2vrfef03etdpre50fbvxafjssw0r5ewr2tp" timestamp="1523587679"&gt;10&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Sofia, A. Sathya&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Ganeshkumar, P.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Multi-objective Task Scheduling to Minimize Energy Consumption and Makespan of Cloud Computing Using NSGA-II&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Journal of Network &amp;amp; Systems Management&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Journal of Network &amp;amp; Systems Management&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;1-23&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;26&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;1&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2017&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_89">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">89</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。为了有效的控制能量，他们将动态电压频率调节系统纳入优化程序中，并使用非支配排序遗传算法（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">NSGA-II</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）获得一组非统治解决方案。此外，他们还采用人工神经网络来进行</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">预测，并且最后提出了在神经网络的支持下和没有人工神经网络支持下的最优化解决方案。他们从电压与频率的角度给出了一种新的解决方案，并解决了云数据中心能量控制问题。但是，在移动云计算工作过程中，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">CPU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">利用率，网络带宽，内存等因素往往更能直观的表示出数据中心的工作负载；</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Ting Yang</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人提出了一种新颖的工作感知</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">布局和路由调度（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">JAVPRS</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）方案</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Yang&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2017&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;11&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[90]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;11&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="s2vrfef03etdpre50fbvxafjssw0r5ewr2tp" timestamp="1523587688"&gt;11&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yang, Ting&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Pen, Haibo&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Li, Wei&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zomaya, Albert Y.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;An energy-efficient virtual machine placement and route scheduling scheme in data center networks&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Future Generation Computer Systems&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Future Generation Computer Systems&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;volume&gt;77&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2017&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_90">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">90</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，以减少数据中心网络（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DCN</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）的能耗，并尽可能多地满足网络</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">QoS</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">（服务质量）要求。他们根据网络通信链路中数据流的特点，合理的迁移大数据流，适度整合小数据流，提高了整个网络的通信速率以及利用率。除了对数据流的迁移和整合之外，他们还采用了交通工程（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">TE</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）技术，以减少传输延迟并增加网络吞吐量。通过文献中的实验数据可以看出，他们的方案成功的节省了能源消耗并且同时减小了通信延迟和网络吞吐量。但是他们只考虑了网络开销问题，对于移动云计算的数据中心而言，影响其能量消耗的因素有很多。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">综上所述，目前已有的移动云计算数据中心的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度方法主要存在两个方面的问题，一方面是现有的移动云计算的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度方法不能满足现在的需求；另一方面，现有的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度策略，大多数都考虑的不全面，或者仅仅是从一个方面的不同角度考虑。因此，本文在充分考虑了降低移动云数据中心能耗和提高数据中心效用的基础上，提出了基于能耗和效用的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VMSA-EU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，并设计了基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">NSGAII</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度算法来求解该模型。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="21" styleName="heading 2">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">多目标</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">优化问题</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">实际上，现实生活中的很多问题都可以看作是多目标优化问题（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Multi-objective Optimization Problem,MOP</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）。因此，自</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1960</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">年以来，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MOP</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">吸引了众多不同背景的研究人员的目光，并吸引了越来越多的人参与研究。通常情况下，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MOP</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的多个子目标之间是相互制约的，一个子目标的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">性能得到了优化有可能引起其他子目标的性能降低。想要使得所有的子目标同时取到最优解是不存在的，但是可以通过协调或折中处理，使得每个子目标都接近于最优解。与单目标优化不同的是，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MOP</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的解并非唯一，可能有多个解</plain_text>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="21" styleName="heading 2">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">虚拟机调度模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">本文从</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">CPU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">、内存、网络带宽和硬盘</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">4</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">种资源考虑，将</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度模型看成是装箱问题。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的调度是将</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">合理地部署到服务器中，把服务器看作箱子，把</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">看作要装箱的物品，服务器可提供的资源空间为箱子的容量，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的所用资源空间为物品的大小。装箱问题具有复杂性，因此需要联合一个多目标优化算法来进行求解。本章给出了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度的三个目标，每个目标对应一个函数，从而将装箱问题转换为带约束的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MOP</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。为了求解</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MOP</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">本文采用基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">NSGAII</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的多目标优化算法来求解。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="31" styleName="heading 3">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">相关定义及概念</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">当前云计算服务提供商在搭建平台时考虑最多的是成本问题，最小能耗和最大效用成为了各大提供商共同的追求。本节根据上文提出的相关定义和约束条件给出了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">通常在虚拟资源调度的优化阶段，物理资源利用率较低的节点上所运行的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">要被迁移到其它合适的物理节点上，并将该节点设为休眠状态，能进一步减少数据中心的能量消耗。因此在移动云计算环境下的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调度方法，在考虑了最小能耗和最大效用这两个因素后，并且还满足所用的服务器数尽可能的小，这样也能进一步减少数据中心的能量消耗。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的多目标优化算法来求解该</plain_text>
      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">VMSA-EU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">NSGA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">II</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">NSGAII</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法的基本思想为</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">:</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">首先</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">产生随机的初始种群，经过</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">FNS</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">后通过遗传算法的选择、交叉、变异三个基本操作得到第一代子代种群。其次</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在第</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">代开始</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">把父代种群的个体与子代种群的个体归总</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">进行</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">FNS,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">同时对每个非支配层中的个体进行密集距离计算，在选择时，通过比较个体之间的支配与非支配关系、个体的密集度来选出较优秀的个体进入新的父代种群</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">最后</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">通过遗传算法的基本操作产生新的子代种群</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">依此类推</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">直到满足程序结束的条件</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
