      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">当萤火虫寻求食物或寻找配偶时，它们通过荧光素相互作用。在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">GSO</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中，每个萤火虫的位置代表一个解决方案，它们全体的集合构成一个解决方案空</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">间。初始萤火虫组的位置信息在搜索空间中随机给出，然后每个萤火虫使用概率机制向具有大于其自身荧光素值的邻居移动。萤光素值越大，萤火虫的吸引力就越强。在几个步骤的迭代之后，更多的萤火虫聚集在一个位置，具有高萤光素值，该位置就是我们的最优解。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">GSO</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法主要分为六个步骤：</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">对萤火虫群进行初始化，对</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">GSO</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法中的一些参数进行设定。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">针对每一个萤火虫进行荧光素的更新，对于第</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <drawing_object tag="drawing_object" kind="object">
          <image tag="image" relationshipId="rId553" target="word/media/image274.wmf" />
          <shape tag="shape" sourceElement="v:shape" />
        </drawing_object>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">次迭代，其更新方法如</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">公式</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> GOTOBUTTON ZEqnNum694961  \* MERGEFORMAT </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> REF ZEqnNum694961 \* Charformat \! \* MERGEFORMAT </plain_text>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">如算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">4-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">所示，经过多次迭代，算法将收敛于一个点，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">即</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">荧光素最大的那个萤火虫</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的位置</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。此时，该萤火虫的位置即为所求的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">混合</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">小波支持向量回归模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HWSVR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">参数组合的最优取值。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="21" styleName="heading 2">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HWSVR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型的主机负载预测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于移动云计算数据中心的主机负载具有非线性、非稳定性等特点，对其进行预测变得非常困难。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">而小波支持向量回归模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">可以充分运用小波变换优势，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">可以对负载瞬时序列进行分析，从而能够更好地对负载序列进行回归分析</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">并</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">对于云计算负载能够有效地进行预测</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Zhong&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2017&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;142&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[114]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;142&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="ve25zvdskavf9nesxvkv9a07fdftwwt0w0v9"&gt;142&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zhong, Wei&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zhuang, Yi&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Sun, Jian&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Gu, Jingjing&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;The cloud computing load forecasting algorithm based on wavelet support vector machine&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Australasian Computer Science Week Multiconference&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;38&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2017&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在移动云计算数据中心，主机负载类型主要有</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">CPU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">、内存、网络带宽和磁盘。由于移动云计算系统中的需求方为移动终端，因此移动云计算数据中心的负载具有一定的随机性和不确定性。另一方面，由于移动用户在使用云计算服务过程中受时间因素影响，因此数据中心的主机负载又具有一定的规律性，能够通过对历史数据的规律挖掘，对未来的主机负载进行分析和预测。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

        </drawing_object>

    </paragraph>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">通过对移动云计算数据中心主机负载的分析，本文利用混合小波支持向量回归模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HWSVR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">对其进行回归和预测，并提出了一种基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HWSVR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型的主机负载预测算法。算法分为三个阶段，分别为数据预处理、模型训练以及负载预测阶段。在数据预处理过程中，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">首先需要对移动云计算数据中心的主机负载数据进行归一化处理。在本章</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中采用逻辑规约函数进行归一化处理，逻辑规约函数如</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">公式</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> GOTOBUTTON ZEqnNum991262  \* MERGEFORMAT </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> REF ZEqnNum991262 \* Charformat \! \* MERGEFORMAT </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(4.14)</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">所示。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">	</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

          <image tag="image" relationshipId="rId628" target="word/media/image309.wmf" />

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">	</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> MACROBUTTON MTPlaceRef \* MERGEFORMAT </plain_text>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在模型训练过程中，使用数据中心的主机负载数据对提出的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HWSVR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型进行训练。主机负载通过预处理阶段的归一化处理之后，作为样本数据带入到</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HWSVR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型中，以确定模型中的部分参数。同时，为了提升</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HWSVR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型的预测精度，本</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">章</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">设计了一个基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">GSO</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的参数寻优算法，以寻找</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HWSVR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型的参数组合</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <drawing_object tag="drawing_object" kind="object">
          <image tag="image" relationshipId="rId630" target="word/media/image310.wmf" />
          <shape tag="shape" sourceElement="v:shape" />
        </drawing_object>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型决策函数的输入。该决策函数如</plain_text>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> GOTOBUTTON ZEqnNum662396  \* MERGEFORMAT </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> REF ZEqnNum662396 \* Charformat \! \* MERGEFORMAT </plain_text>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为了验证本文提出的算法和模型的预测性能，需要与同类预测算法进行对比实验。本文选择了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">调整支持向量回归算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">TSVR</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DLHB</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">该算法由基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ARIMA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">预测域间心跳算法和域内心跳检测算法两部分组成。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">实验结果表明</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">提出的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DLHB</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法能够同时检测多个节点故障，具有更短的检测时间。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="21" styleName="heading 2">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">引言</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">随着云计算技术和移动互联网的飞速发展，为满足用户对移动终端应用逐渐增加的需求，移动云计算技术应运而生。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云计算由云计算发展而来，继承了云计算的诸多优点同时也具有终端资源有限性、接入网异构性以及无线网络的安全脆弱性等特性。目前，移动云计算技术得到了迅速的发展，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">并且</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在军事、医疗、教育、金融等领域将会承担越来越重要</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">作用。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云数据中心是一个具有资源量大、数据运算与存储性能高等特点的信息中枢，向用户提供了方便的服务。随着云计算技术的广泛应用，云计算中心凭借大量的服务器组成资源池，提供资源存储、计算等服务。但硬件和软件的高度复杂化也为数据中心的正常运作带来隐患。当节点发生故障，影响移动云数据中心的运作时，如何保证数据中心的持续可靠运行已成为移动云服务能否成功应用的关键。因此需要研究一种故障检测方法对数据中心服务器节点进行实时性监控，以保证出现故障时系统能迅速采取有效措施提高移动云数据中心的抗毁性。失效检测是提高移动云数据中心可靠性的关键技术，只有检测到节点失效，才能进行系统的快速恢复。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">故障</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">检测技术是实现系统容错的基础与前提</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">于爱华</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2010&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;25&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[120]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;25&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;25&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Thesis"&gt;32&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">分布式实时容错系统的设计与实现</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">&lt;/title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2010&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;publisher&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">大连理工大学</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">&lt;/publisher&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_120">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">120</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，其功能为检测系统中节点是否故障并做出回应信息。由于其原理简单、检测成功率高而成为提高移动云数据中心可靠性的一个常用方法。移动云数据中心中各节点定期交换“心跳包”以检测各节点的健康状态，若检测发现故障，则启动相应的故障恢复机制</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。心跳包超时是判断节点故障的一个重要准则。导致心跳包超时的原因虽然有多种，但是最基本的原因是节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">与网路的故障或</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">网络延时。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">计算机系统性能的不断提高同时带来了其功耗、成本以及编程的复杂性提高，这种矛盾在嵌入式计算机系统中尤为突出</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_121">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">121</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云系统</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中，由于其</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">计算和通信能力有限，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">节点的异构性以及网络环境的多样性</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，网络延时问题不可避免。因此，在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云系统</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中，尤其是在无线网络的情况下，网络延迟也是一个导致故障的主要原因。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">目前的心跳检测算法不能很好地应用于移动云系统中。本文针对这一问题，提出了一种面向异构移动云的双层心跳检测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DLHB</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。该算法将</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云数据中心中</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的节点根据其物理位置划分区域，并在域间和域内分别进行节点的心跳检测。实验结果表明，该算法适用于具有异构</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">特性的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">环境</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="21" styleName="heading 2">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">相关研究</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">对于移动云平台，如何增强其容错性以提高系统可靠性是该领域的研究方向之一。目前在若干相关领域已取得较多研究成果，具体包括故障检测技术、可靠性分析技术等。故障检测是实现系统容错的前提。故障检测技术可分为依赖于模型和不依赖模型的两大类技术。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">早期常用依赖于模型的故障检测方法，包括基于状态估计和基于参数估计的检测方法。基于状态估计的检测方法通过构造状态观测器估计系统状态，从而得出系统输出估计值。如</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Saif</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人提出了一种基于故障检测方法，该方法通过设计未知输入的观测器得到系统输出值</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Saif&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;1993&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;34&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[122]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;34&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;34&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Saif, M.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Guan, Y.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;A new approach to robust fault detection and identification&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;IEEE Transactions on Aerospace &amp;amp; Electronic Systems&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;IEEE Transactions on Aerospace &amp;amp; Electronic Systems&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;685-695&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;29&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;3&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;1993&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_122">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">122</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Caliskan</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">和</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Keller</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人分别提出了将卡尔曼滤波器与传感器相结合的检测方法</plain_text>

      </text_run>

Y.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Fault isolation filter design for linear stochastic systems </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。后来</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Juricic</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人结合数理统计学设计了一种随机系统的参数估计方法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Juričić&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2002&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;23&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[47]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;23&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;23&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Đani Juričić&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Žele, Mina&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Robust detection of sensor faults by means of a statistical</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。两种方法各有优劣，基于状态估计的检测方法实时性较好但收敛性较差；基于参数估计的方法要求存在激烈信号，而基于状态估计的检测方法没有严格要求。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">随着系统日益复杂，基于模型的检测方法在建模时越来越困难，因此产生了不依赖模型的检测方法，其主要分为基于信号的方法和基于知识的方法。基于信号的方法通过对输出信号的参数进行分析来获得故障信息。基于知识的方法包括利用模糊逻辑的方法、</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Petri</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">网的方法等智能方法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。目前，包括遗传算法、神经网络等优化算法已被广泛应用到模型参数的优化中</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Li&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2000&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;15&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[49]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;15&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;15&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Li, Xiaoou&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yu, Wen&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Lara-Rosano, F.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Dynamic knowledge inference and learning under adaptive fuzzy Petri net framework&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;IEEE Transactions on Systems Man &amp;amp; Cybernetics Part C&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;IEEE Transactions on Systems Man &amp;amp; Cybernetics Part C&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;442-450&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;30&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;4&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2000&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，但存在收敛速度慢、拟合精度较低等问题。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">目前已经提出了大量的故障检测算法，如</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">t-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">故障一步检测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Aguilera&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;1997&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;6&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[50]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;6&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;6&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Aguilera, Marcos Kawazoe&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Chen, Wei&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Toueg, Sam&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Heartbeat: A timeout-free failure detector for quiescent reliable communication&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;International Workshop on Distributed Algorithms&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;126-140&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;1997&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_50">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">50</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。该算法由于其条件要求严格，在实际应用中很难得到满足，故研究人员又提出了心跳检测算法，该算法通过节点向其他节点发送心跳包来判断节点是否出现故障。但随着系统规模增大，通信量成非线性增长趋势，因此，后续研究者们不断改进，又提出了多种动态心跳检测算法，将系统当前的网络状况等因素考虑到算法中，可有效地减少心跳检测的通信量。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">最基本的心跳模型有“推模型”和“拉模型”</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Gouda&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;1998&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;7&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[126]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;7&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;7&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Gouda, M. G&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Mcguire, T. M&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Accelerated heartbeat protocols&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;International Conference on Distributed Computing Systems, 1998. Proceedings&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;202-209&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;1998&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_126">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">126</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。“推模型”中一般节点周期性地向主控节点主动发送心跳包，“拉模型”中主控节点主动询问被监测节点的状态信息，被监测节点回复响应心跳包。然而，“推模型”容易因网络延迟造成心跳包超时，易造成对健康节点的误判；“拉模型”一次检测需要传输两个心跳包，在系统规模较大的情况下，通信开销也较大。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">近年来，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">基于以上两种基本模型，已有一系列进一步改进的研究成果。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">“双模型”</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">北京航空航天大学学报</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;952-956&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;39&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;7&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2013&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">127</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">是一种针对“推模型”误判率高和“拉模型”通信开销大的缺点而设计的心跳检测模型。它结合了“推模型”和“拉模型”的优点，其工作过程可以分为两个阶段：在阶段一，所有被监控节点周期性地发送自己的心跳包。若监控节点发送的心跳包并没有得到回应，则进入“拉模型”阶段，主动询问其状态信息；若被监控节点未发生故障，则在收到询问信息后向监控节点回复自己的心跳包。“双模型”简单地将“推模型”与“拉模型”相结合，其实现</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">简单，但对于规模较大的系统，大量的心跳包会影响系统的性能。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Z. Hou</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">提出了一种分布式心跳机制</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Hou&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2003&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;12&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[52]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;12&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;12&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Hou, Zonghao&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Huang, Yongxiang&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zheng, Shouqi&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Dong, Xiaoshe&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wang, Bingkang&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Design and implementation of heartbeat in multi-machine environment&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;International Conference on Advanced Information NETWORKING and Applications&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;583-586&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2003&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_52">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">52</plain_text>
        </text_run>
