      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DHM</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Distributed Heartbeat </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Mechanism</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">），它包括一个</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">主节点和多个从节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，各节点运行相同的但处于不同状态的心跳进程。主节点由各节点选举产生，它使用“拉模型”检测各从节点的状态信息。而主节点的状态则由各从节点协同判断，从节点首先向主节点“拉”回其状态信息，若在一个预期时间内未收到回复，则从节点会选举判断主节点的状态信息。若主节点失效，则新主节点的选举</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">将</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">会在所有从节点中进行</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">这</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">一方法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">对于较大规模的系统，网络开销也是相当大的。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">董新华等人提出了一种根据作业执行时间来调整心跳检测频率的算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">周湾湾</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">54</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，该算法可以</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">自</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">适应不同作业大小的情</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">况，当节点作业相对较小时，为了避免频繁的心跳检测而增加网络负载自动降低心跳频率；</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">而作业相对较大时，为了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">能够及时发现节点故障会尽量增加心跳频率。但该算法忽略了网络环境</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">影响，因此不能很好地适用于网络环境多变的环境中。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Fei-fei Li</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">提出了一种多级心跳协议</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Li&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2009&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;13&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[53]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;13&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;13&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Book"&gt;6&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Li, Fei Fei&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yu, Xiang Zhan&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wu, Gang&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Design and Implementation of High Availability Distributed System Based on Multi-level Heartbeat Protocol&lt;/title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;83-87&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2009&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;publisher&gt;IEEE Computer Society&lt;/publisher&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_53">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">53</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MLHP</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Multi-Level Heartbeat Protocol</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">及算法，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">将节点按功能划分为控制节点和计算节点，每个控制节点管理一组计算节点。控制节点间相互进行心跳检测，若有控制节点失效，则将其从拓扑结构中删除。计算节点的状态由其对应的控制节点进行检测。控制节点周期地向其管理域内的计算节点“拉”回状态信息，若有计算节点失效则将其删除。同时计算节点会运行一个计时器，若在规定时间内未收到其控制节点的“询问”信息则会寻找另一个控制节点加入其管理域。该协议在较大规模的系统中能表现较好的性能，这是因为它将节点分组进行心跳检测，而不需要所有节点之间相互进行心跳包的交互，可以大幅度减少因为心跳检测而带来的网络负载。但其不足之处在于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">需要使用额外的节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">来进行计算节点的管理，且对于各类心跳包均采用固定的超时时间，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">因此</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">不能很好地适应网络的不确定性。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">以上算法均未考虑</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云数据中心</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中网络的延时问题。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">异构云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于节点的计算能力有限，且由于节点的异构性，各节点间的通信代价不相同，网络延时就会变得不确定。此时若还是采用固定的心跳包超时阈值的方法，则可能会加大误判的可能性。因为，此时被监控节点可能是正常的，只不过其向监控节点发送的心跳包在传输过程中由于网络原因发生延时或丢失，若此时监控节点判断被监控节点为失效显然是不正确的。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">YI Su</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等人提出了一种多因素心跳检测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Su&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2017&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;22&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[55]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;22&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;22&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Journal Article"&gt;17&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Su, Y. I.&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yin, Huiwen&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wang, Chuang&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zhang, Yichuan&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Research on multi factor adaptive heartbeat detection algorithm&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Computer Engineering &amp;amp; Applications&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;periodical&gt;&lt;full-title&gt;Computer Engineering &amp;amp; Applications&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2017&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_55">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">55</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">H</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">D</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">etection </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">A</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">lgorithm</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，它采用“拉模型”的心跳机制，主节点周期性</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">地</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">向从节点发送心跳询问信息，从节点再向主节点发送</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">回复</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">心跳包</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。“</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">拉模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">”</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的网络开销要比</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">“</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">推模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">”</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">大得多，为了解决这一点，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">需要设计</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">多因素</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">心跳检测</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">评价</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">综合各因素计算出适合当前系统的最优心跳频率。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">但</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">其不足之处在于对较大型的服务器集群系统来说，采用主从式架构收集各节点的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">CPU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">占用率</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">及</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">网络负载情况</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等信息将会有较大的通信开销，且降低心跳频率并不能保证节点故障检</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">测的准确率。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于节点的异构性以及网络环境的多样性</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，故也不能保证降低节点故障检测的误判率。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">王浩铭</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">&lt;/full-title&gt;&lt;/periodical&gt;&lt;pages&gt;212-214&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;volume&gt;41&lt;/volume&gt;&lt;number&gt;b11&lt;/number&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2014&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_56">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">56</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，将“拉模式”与“推模式”进行优势互补，并将网络环境考虑在内。首先启动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">P</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">USH</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">检测阶段，主节点根据从节点回复的心跳信息的延迟时间计算出每个节点的超时期望；当超时时间达到超时期望时，疑似该节点失效并迅速启动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">P</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ULL</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">检测机制，主节点周期性地发送心跳信号，从节点接到消息后立即回复相同标志的心跳信号，通过统计传输时间计算出一个关于可信度值ρ，并与自适应的失效阈值进行对比来判断节点是否失效。虽然该心跳检测机制可简化全盘使用“拉模式”的系统开销，但在复杂网络环境下其通讯开销以及检测准确率还需进一步提高。在移动云计算大规模的数据中心上，上述算法依然会有效率较低的问题，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">因此</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">这些</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法不能很好的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">直接</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">适</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">用于移动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云环境中。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">目前，还有一些研究工作通过预测心跳包的到达时间来减少误判。如</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Liu Fen</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">g</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">采用</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">最近一段时间的心跳包延迟时间的均值来预测下一次心跳包的到达时间</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Lei&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2010&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;14&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[59]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;14&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;14&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Lei, Zeng&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Liu, Feng&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yang, Songhua&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zheng, Heng&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Dynamic heartbeat algorithm of redundant mechanisms in WIA-PA&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Information Technology&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;621-624&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2010&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_59">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">59</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DHB</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Dynamic heartbeat algorithm</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。该方法简单易行，也考虑了网络变化对心跳包到</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">达</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">时间的影响，但其预测准确性却很低</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Zhao Hai-jun</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">采用人工神经网络</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Zhao&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2009&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;17&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[60]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;17&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;17&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Zhao, Haijun&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Yan, Ma&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Huang, Xiaohong&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Fang, Zhao&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;Forecasting Heartbeat Delay for Failure Detection over Internet Using Nonlinear System&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;Wri World Congress on Computer Science and Information Engineering&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;589-593&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2009&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_60">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">60</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">来预测心跳包的到达时间，虽然提高了预测的准确性，但其算法复杂，对于实时性要求较高的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">系统来说无法使用。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">本文</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在分析了已有研究工作优缺点的基础上，提出了一种面向</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的双层心跳检测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DLHB</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">将</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云数据中心</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中的节点根据物理位置划分区域，域间的心跳检测</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">引入了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">预测</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">机制来减少由于网络延迟造成的误判，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">域内</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的心跳检测</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">采用消息复杂度较低的心跳环机制。该算法不仅具有较高的检测成功率，而且具有较短的检测时间。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="21" styleName="heading 2">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">面向</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云计算</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="14" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的双层心跳检测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云计算是移动计算的发展，也是云计算的延伸。在移动云计算</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，先前基于移动设备的密集计算，数据存储和海量信息处理</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">均</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">已经转移到</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云端</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，从而降低了移动设备在计算能力和资源方面的需求。另一方面，人们用于访问和获取云服务的终端</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">能够</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">适用于智能手机</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">、</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">PDA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">与</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">iPad</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">智能</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动设备，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">且</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">不限于固定设备（如</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">PC</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">），</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">也体现</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">了智能</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动设备</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的优点和</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">设计</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">初衷</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为了具备超级计算和海量存储的能力，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云计算</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">数据中心</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">通常由数千台服务器组成。例如，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Google</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云计算已经控制了全球</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">200</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">个不同地点的所有服务器</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">数量</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">％，并且在未来十年内将升至</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1000</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">万台服务器</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">这种云系统</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中，由于其</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">计算和通信能力有限，且</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于节点的异构性以及网络环境的多样性</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，网络延时问题不可避免。因此，在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云系统</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">中，尤其是在无线网络的情况下，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">如何降低由于节点的异构性以及网络环境多样性而造成的节点故障的误判率是一个关键技术。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="31" styleName="heading 3">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">双层心跳检测模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">快速、准确的心跳检测机制是实现移动云数据中心容错的基础与前提，也是提高移动云系统可靠性的重要方法，通过对各节点周期性的故障检测并采取相应的措施保证移动云数据中心的可靠运作。通常，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动云</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">环境中，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于各节点的异构性，网络通信代价差异会较大。同一物理区域的节点通信代价相对较小，而不同物理区域的节点通信代价相对较大</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">且不稳定</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为了降低网络资源消耗并提高移动云数据中心节点失效检测的成功率</plain_text>

      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">带</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">M</plain_text>
      </text_run>
