      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">小圆圈表示主控节点，无符号的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">空白</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">小圆圈表示普通节点</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，一个环中的主控节点与其余普通节点所在位置构成一个物理区域，在该域内节点之间的通信代价一般较小。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <drawing_object tag="drawing_object" kind="object">
          <image tag="image" relationshipId="rId674" target="word/media/image332.wmf" />
          <shape tag="shape" sourceElement="v:shape" />
        </drawing_object>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为令牌心跳包，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <drawing_object tag="drawing_object" kind="object">
          <image tag="image" relationshipId="rId676" target="word/media/image333.wmf" />
          <shape tag="shape" sourceElement="v:shape" />
        </drawing_object>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为响应心跳包。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">考虑系统的实时性要求，提出的算法模型所基于的拓扑结构以逻辑令牌环为基础。如图</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">所示，域内仅通过令牌心跳包和响应心跳包进行检测，域间通过统一设计的状态信息包进行检测，这样可以避免异构系统造成的复杂性。我们按照网络通信代价将节点划分为不同的域，网络通信代价较小，且网络状况相对稳定的节点划分为一个域。每一个</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">域</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由一个主控节点和其余普通节点构成。主控节点产生域内逻辑环检测心跳包，所有节点构成一个逻辑环状结构，为了检测环内节点是否发生故障，检测心跳包沿着节点依次转发。为了使各主控节点保存每个域中所有节点的状态信息，所有主控节点会将各自域内普通节点的状态信息通过心跳包发送至其它所有域的主控节点。根据</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">REF _Ref511942634 \h</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">图 5.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">所示的模型，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">DLHB</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法由域间主控节点的心跳检测算法和域内节点的心跳检测算法两部分组成。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <drawing_object tag="drawing_object" kind="object">
          <image tag="image" relationshipId="rId678" target="word/media/image334.emf" />
          <shape tag="shape" sourceElement="v:shape" />

      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="ad" styleName="caption">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法模型</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="31" styleName="heading 3">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">基于</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ARMA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的心跳包预测方法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">AR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">I</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型（</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average Model,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">）是</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">对平稳时间序列研究的重要方法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，它由</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，适合取样周期为秒级的应用环境。基于以上分析，为使数据趋于平稳，我们在</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">A</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">RMA</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">5.1</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">t</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">个心跳包与第</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">t</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

          <image tag="image" relationshipId="rId694" target="word/media/image342.wmf" />

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于心跳包的到达时间间隔受网络环境的影响，不一定具有平稳性，故我们加上一阶差分过程使其平稳化。一般随机序列</plain_text>

            </text_run>

            </text_run>

              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">then  </plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">T</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">timeout</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">= </plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">T</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">thr</plain_text>

            </text_run>

              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">13.                      </plain_text>
            </text_run>

              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">updateOverTime()</plain_text>
            </text_run>

            </text_run>

            </text_run>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="31" styleName="heading 3">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">域内心跳检测算法</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于本文</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">是根据物理位置对节点进行</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">区域划分，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">故物理位置相同的节点其通信代价相对较小，因此域内我们使用复杂度较低的心跳环算法进行故障检测</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">文献</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADDIN EN.CITE &lt;EndNote&gt;&lt;Cite&gt;&lt;Author&gt;Lu&lt;/Author&gt;&lt;Year&gt;2006&lt;/Year&gt;&lt;RecNum&gt;5&lt;/RecNum&gt;&lt;DisplayText&gt;&lt;style face="superscript"&gt;[136]&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/DisplayText&gt;&lt;record&gt;&lt;rec-number&gt;5&lt;/rec-number&gt;&lt;foreign-keys&gt;&lt;key app="EN" db-id="055epvd5dtr9zjee9eaxs9sqv9dsetxazzax"&gt;5&lt;/key&gt;&lt;/foreign-keys&gt;&lt;ref-type name="Conference Proceedings"&gt;10&lt;/ref-type&gt;&lt;contributors&gt;&lt;authors&gt;&lt;author&gt;Lu, Yutong&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Wang, Min&lt;/author&gt;&lt;author&gt;Xiao, Nong&lt;/author&gt;&lt;/authors&gt;&lt;/contributors&gt;&lt;titles&gt;&lt;title&gt;A New Heartbeat Mechanism for Large-Scale Cluster&lt;/title&gt;&lt;secondary-title&gt;International Conference on Advanced Web and Network Technologies, and Applications&lt;/secondary-title&gt;&lt;/titles&gt;&lt;pages&gt;610-619&lt;/pages&gt;&lt;dates&gt;&lt;year&gt;2006&lt;/year&gt;&lt;/dates&gt;&lt;urls&gt;&lt;/urls&gt;&lt;/record&gt;&lt;/Cite&gt;&lt;/EndNote&gt;</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <hyperlink tag="hyperlink" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" anchor="_ENREF_136">
        <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
          <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">136</plain_text>
        </text_run>
      </hyperlink>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">提出了消息复杂度为</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">O(</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">n</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">)</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">heartbeat ring</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">算法，它可以用少量的心跳包进行单点故障检测。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">然而若仅由主副节点保存环内节点的配置信息，当其均失效时会丢失心跳环的配置信息</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，且无法检测出多节点同时出现的故障。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">定义</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">5-2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">：</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">设</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">域内节点集合为</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <drawing_object tag="drawing_object" kind="object">
          <image tag="image" relationshipId="rId754" target="word/media/image372.wmf" />
          <shape tag="shape" sourceElement="v:shape" />
        </drawing_object>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">m</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">按</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">节点逻辑顺序循环转发。</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HBt</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1.   begin Initialization</plain_text>

            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2.          CreateHeartBeat() //</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">主控节点创建检测心跳包</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">3.          SendDetectHeartBeat() //</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">主控节点发送检测心跳包</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HBt</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">4.   end Initialization</plain_text>
            </text_run>

            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">5.   while system working</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">6.        if  ReceiveDetectHeartBeat()==True   //</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

            </text_run>

              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Nk</plain_text>
            </text_run>

            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HBt</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">7.            then SendResponseHeartBeat()//</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">向节点</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Nt-1</plain_text>
            </text_run>

              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">回复响应心跳包</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HBr</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">8.                SendDetectHeartBeat()//</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">将</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">转发给节点</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Nk+1</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">并启动心跳计时器</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">9.            if  ReceiveResponseHeartBeat()==False//</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">在时间阈值内未收到节点</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Nk+1</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">10.               then ResetTimer() //</plain_text>
            </text_run>

            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">11.                   AddFaultInfo() //</plain_text>

              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">将节点</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Nk+1</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">故障的标志加入令牌心跳包</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HBt</plain_text>

          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">12.                   SendDetectHeartBeat()//</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">向节点</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Nk+2</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">发送令牌心跳包</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">HBt</plain_text>
            </text_run>
          </paragraph>
          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">为了测试所提出算法的性能，我们进行了如下实验。实验环境为由</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">16</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">台普通</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">PC</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">机和交换机连接的局域网。由于本文提出的心跳算法的主要新颖之处是采用</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">AR</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">I</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">模型来预测域间心跳包的到达时间，故我们采用</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">16</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">台</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">PC</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">机，针对不同算法预测到达时间与实际到达时间的误差来评判算法的性能。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">心跳检测机制</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">由于其原理简单</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">、易实现等优势</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">而成为</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">一种最常用的故障检测方法。针对较大型云数据中心服务器系统，考虑节点的异构性以及网络环境的多样性，如何设计出速度更快、网络开销更低以及较低的故障检测误判率是移动云数据中心心跳检测机制面临的主要问题。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">本文分析了心跳检测机制在移动云数据中心可能造成的检测效率较低、网络开销较大以及故障误判率较高等问题，综合考虑了云中节点的异构性以及网络环境的多样性对心跳监测机制的影响，为了提高移动云系统故障检测效率，</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">以保证出现故障时系统能迅速采取有效措施提高云数据中心的抗毁性</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，本文</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">提出</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">了</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">一种</plain_text>
      </text_run>

      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">MA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">预测的双层心跳检测</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">（</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">节点根据物理位置划分区域，域间的心跳检测引入了</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ARIMA</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">预测机制来减少由于网络延迟造成的误判，域内的心跳检测采用消息复杂度较低的心跳环机制</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">，进一步保证移动云系统中心跳检测机制的准确性，提高了故障检测的性能。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">从上至下</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">又包括</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">基础设施服务层、资源服务层。基础设施服务层包括若干高性能计算服务器、大容量存储磁盘阵列、千兆以太网络、万兆</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">以太网</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">络、机架和冷却设备等物理设备（资源），以及内核操作系统、资源虚拟化软件和</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Openstack</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">规范的</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云平台管理软件等云数据中心基础软件。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云数据中心基础软件采用风河公司</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">“</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">T</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">itanuim Cloud</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">”</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云操作系统，支持构建物理资源虚拟化池，并通过提供虚拟机</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">创建、销毁</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">、</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">重启、迁移、</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">暂停、启动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">等操作</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">接口为用户提供定制的虚拟机服务。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">平台</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">服务层位于基础设施服务层之上，作为移动云资源管理平台的核心，对下通过调用基础设施服务层虚拟机操作接口应用基础设施服务，对上为软件服务层提供云计算平台服务，完成资源监控和预测、任务响应和分配、虚拟机选择和调度（必要时包括构建/销毁）、故障诊断和恢复等功能，实现整个移动云资源的统一管理、按需分配和共享使用，并通过提供各种资源使用接口，为各专业、各舰船提供透明平台服务。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">软件服务层由领域软件开发者开发、注册的专业应用软件，为本船各部门以及其他舰船提供平台管理、动力操控，目标探测、作战指挥、目标打击等软件服务。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="afff8" styleName="正文样式">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">移动</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">舰船私有</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">云通过本船以太网络为多专业、多部门提供基础设施、平台和软件服务，通</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="宋体" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="#000000" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">过加密无线网络（如数据链系统）为友船提供基础设施、平台和软件服务。</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
